skills.title: Reusable Skills
skills.description: Install proven workflows like code review, TDD, and debugging as ready-to-use skills.

agents.title: Specialist Agents

commands.title: Custom Commands
commands.description: Simplify your development workflow with project-specific custom commands.

hooks.title: Hooks
hooks.description: Extend your workflow with event-driven automation. Connect to commits, builds, deploys, and more.

packages.title: Packages
packages.description: Bundled collections of skills and agents that you can install all at once.

guides.title: Usage Guides
guides.description: Check out coding agent tips, tricks, and best practices.

lazyLoading.title: Use Instantly, No Local Install
lazyLoading.description: No need to download skills in advance. With MCP server connected, skills are loaded on demand and always up to date.

autoRecommend.title: Context-Aware Auto Recommendations
autoRecommend.description: Your coding agent reads the context and automatically finds and applies relevant skills. Just describe what you need in natural language.

multiAgent.title: Works With Any Coding Agent
multiAgent.description: Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, AITK CLI — share the same skills across any tool. Your team's know-how stays even when tools change.
